beats.name: A. The people
beats.blurb: Every homeless household in England, true scale: 134,000 tiny figures under one teal light.

beats.name: B. The homes
beats.blurb: The camera pulls back: beside them, every long-term empty home (303,185), dark. The people become a smudge.

beats.name: C. Who owns this one?
beats.blurb: One empty house's light flicks on. The question, and BadCode's line (Jack's).
